latest_release.name: v1.4.0
latest_release.body:
## Downloads
- **`gamenative-v1.4.0.apk`** — Standard build. Recommended for most users.
- **`gamenative-v1.4.0-legacy-xr.apk`** — XR build for Quest headsets.


## What's Changed

### Added since prerelease
* Various Gamescope fixes by @joshuatam and me
* Improve Windows VR on Mali GPUs by @lahed in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2249
* WinHandler: skip unchanged gamepad sends, keep the send and receive threads alive by @kudyk in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2062
* fix: route X11 button releases using release subscriptions by @tapionallanaire in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2110
* fix: download no longer fails with "resolves outside the install dir" on Android storage by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2258
* feat: Add a launcher orientation button to the System menu by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2191
* Proton 11.0-2 rebuild 9 as the default: Android build with XFixes (fixes button presses not going through) in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2264
* Fix launches on ColorOS 17 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2289
* Fix issue where Steam library did not fully populate in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2301
* Added toggle for showing "Limiting factor" (eg heat, cpu, gpu) in the performance HUD in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2315
* Add Turkish localization by @emrinolur in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2291
* fix: Added Adaptive Icon Monochrome support to GameNative by @TreeNinjaPRO in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2310
* Fixes for SurfaceFlinger renderer - no need for compatibility mode in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2325
* Improving Japanese Translations by @Tak-attack in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2239
* Reduce 3 largest sources of ANRs in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2330 and https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2331
* Manifest: Turnip Gen8 V38, Turnip v27.0.0-R1, DXVK 3.1.1, vkd3d-proton 3.1 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2343

### From prerelease
* **Potential breaking change:** Added gamescope as default renderer for Adreno - low latency, upscaling, HDR, and ReShade + support and LSFG by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2220 - all videos available at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16Nl3GJFX4Oqglgs1LrPJp9fkfJxHpq9E
* Improve redistributable installation in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2142
* Various Steam Cloud fixes in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2180 and https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2146
* Fixed Epic games where EOS did not work correctly in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2196
* Add GOG Galaxy service support via Comet in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2195
* Fixed Just Cause 2, Alan Wake, Project Zomboid and other Java games, The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Game of the Year Edition, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Counter-Strike 2, Spelunky 2, DRAGON BALL FighterZ, Sid Meier's Civilization V - **click use known config**
* Fixed Battle.net (Diablo II: Resurrected, Diablo IV, Overwatch 2) by @dmage22 - changes included in latest proton and fex
* Fixed Age of Empires IV and Age of Empires II: DE by @tarikbc - changes included in the latest proton and fex
* Scale windowed games to the full screen in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2145
* Fix disabled Install button in the game manager dialog on Android TV in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2153
* Fixed certain games not downloading with new downloader by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2187 and https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2188
* fix: ignore the termination of a previous game session by @moi952 in https://github.com/utkarshdala

# GameNative **Play the PC games you already own — from Steam, Epic and GOG — on your Android device, with cloud saves.** [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/utkarshdalal/GameNative?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=latest)](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/releases/latest) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/utkarshdalal/GameNative?style=flat-square&logo=github&color=ffd700)](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/stargazers) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Fapi%2Fv9%2Finvites%2F2hKv4VfZfE%3Fwith_counts%3Dtrue&query=%24.approximate_member_count&style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white&label=discord&color=5865F2&suffix=%20members)](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL%203.0-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/blob/master/LICENSE) [![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/ko--fi-support-FF5E5B?style=flat-square&logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/gamenative) [**Download**](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/releases/download/v1.4.0/gamenative-v1.4.0.apk) · [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE) · [**Support on Ko-fi**](https://ko-fi.com/gamenative)
--- GameNative lets you run the PC games in your Steam, Epic and GOG libraries directly on Android — no streaming required. Your saves sync to the cloud, so you can stop on your PC and keep going on your phone. It's still early. Not every game runs yet, and some need tweaking to play well, but the community is constantly finding and sharing configs that work — and these get applied automatically. You can see if anyone has tried running your game successfully at https://gamenative.app/compatibility. ## What you get - Play games you actually own on Steam, Epic, GOG and Amazon - Cloud saves that carry over between your PC and your phone - Automatically applied known configs, so many games just work out of the box with no tweaking required - Controller and touch support, with a custom control editor and on-screen HUD - Steam DLC, workshop and branch support - Active support over Discord if you need help getting a game running ## Demo [TechDweeb](https://www.youtube.com/@TechDweeb) walks through setting up GameNative on an Android handheld in a couple of minutes:
## How to use 1. Download the latest release [here](https://downloads.gamenative.app/releases/1.4.0/gamenative-v1.4.0.apk) 2. Install the APK on your Android device 3. Log in to your Steam account 4. Install your game 5. Hit play and enjoy ## Support The fastest way to get help is the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE) — we're 35k+ strong and someone's usually around. Please **don't** open issues on GitHub; they're closed automatically. Bring it to Discord instead. If you'd like to chip in, you can support the project on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/gamenative). ## Contributing Want to help out? Message us to get into the **#development** channel on [Discord](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE), or open a thread there. Things we're currently looking for help with live on our [Trello board](https://trello.com/b/vGRkFoAM/open-source-board). ### Fix a game that doesn't work Every night we publish the list of games that don't run in GameNative, built from real usage data, at [GameNative/gamenative-compat](https://github.com/GameNative/gamenative-compat). Each broken game has [an open issue](https://github.com/GameNative/gamenative-compat/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Adoes-not-work) with the numbers behind it: how many players hit it, what they report, whether the game window ever renders. If you want to take one on: 1. Pick a game from the list and open its issue. Check the comments to see whether someone is already on it, then leave a comment saying you are taking it. 2. Work out why it fails. Most fixes land in this repo, in [proton-wine](https://github.com/GameNative/proton-wine), in [FEX](https://github.com/GameNative/FEX), in the GPU driver wrappers or in the per-game config. 3. Open a pull request in the right repo, then comment on the game's issue with a link to it. Once the fix ships and players start getting the game to run, the issue closes itself. Own a broken game and want to donate a key so someone can fix it? Email [support@gamenative.app](mailto:support@gamenative.app). ### Building Most of the time you don't need this — if you just want to play, grab the release above. This is for contributors. 1. Build it like any normal Android Studio project. Ask on Discord if you get stuck. 2. **SteamGridDB API key (optional):** to pull game artwork for custom games, add your key to `local.properties`: ```properties STEAMGRIDDB_API_KEY=your_api_key_here ``` You can get one from your [SteamGridDB preferences](https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences). Without it everything still works — it just won't fetch images. ## Analytics & privacy GameNative uses [PostHog](https://posthog.com) for anonymous analytics. No personal information is ever collected — no names, emails, IPs or device identifiers. **Always collected**, to improve game compatibility: - Game launch, close and exit events (game name, store, session length, average FPS, container config) - Game install, cancel and uninstall events This is how we figure out which games work, how well they run, and which configs to apply automatically for the next person. It can't identify you. **Optional**, and switchable under *Settings → Info → Usage Analytics*: - Feature usage (on-screen keyboard, controller, HUD, control editor) - Login success/failure events - Recommendation interactions - App lifecycle events (foreground/background) - Cloud sync events The full [Privacy Policy](PrivacyPolicy/README.md) has the details. ## Supporters Thanks to our [Ko-fi sponsors](https://ko-fi.com/gamenative) and [GitHub sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/utkarshdalal?preview=true), including [CodeRabbit](https://coderabbit.link/gnative). [![Star History Chart](https://star-history.dera.page/svg?repos=utkarshdalal/GameNative&type=Date&theme=dark)](https://star-history.dera.page/#utkarshdalal/GameNative&Date) ## License [GPL 3.0](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/blob/master/LICENSE). See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES) for attributions, copyleft source offers, and notices about third-party and proprietary components bundled with the app. --- **Disclaimer:** This software is meant for playing games that you legally own. Don't use it for piracy or anything else illegal. The maintainer takes no responsibility for misuse.
